premise: The wind tries to play tag with everything in the forest, and only when everyone holds still does it settle in the grass.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: the wind is a playmate rather than a rival, and stillness, not force, is what calms it.
lesson: Sometimes the way to calm things is to be calm yourself.

en-US.title: The Wind Wants to Play
en-US.text: [curious] Can you feel it? Something is tickling the forest. {canvas:wind 0.6 18s} {sfx:wind-bed} It's the wind, and the wind wants to play tag! {sfx:whoosh} Whoosh! It tags the {tree:enter} tree, and {tree:face happy} {tree:wobble x2} all his leaves giggle. Whoosh! It tags the {butterfly:enter} butterfly, and {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:spin} she twirls round and round. Whoosh! It tags the {pinecone:enter} pinecone, and {pinecone:wobble} she rolls away, and the {acorn:enter} acorn {acorn:hop x3} bounces after her. {all:hop x2} Everyone runs. {all:spin} Everyone spins. {all:face surprised} But nobody can catch the wind! [giggles] Then the tree has an idea. Stand still, he says. {all:face normal} So everyone stands very, very still. [softly] The wind looks around. Nobody is running. So the wind lies down in the long grass, {butterfly:float loop 0.3} curls up… and hums. {all:face happy} [whispers] Shh. The wind is having a rest.

es-ES.title: El viento quiere jugar
es-ES.text: [curious] ¿Lo notáis? Algo le está haciendo cosquillas al bosque. {canvas:wind 0.6 18s} {sfx:wind-bed} ¡Es el viento, y el viento quiere jugar al pillapilla! {sfx:whoosh} ¡Fiuuu! Pilla al {tree:enter} árbol, y {tree:face happy} {tree:wobble x2} todas sus hojas se ríen. ¡Fiuuu! Pilla a la {butterfly:enter} mariposa, y {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:spin} ella da vueltas y vueltas. ¡Fiuuu! Pilla a la {pinecone:enter} piña, y {pinecone:wobble} la piña sale rodando, y la {acorn:enter} bellota {acorn:hop x3} va saltando detrás. {all:hop x2} Todos corren. {all:spin} Todos giran. {all:face surprised} ¡Pero nadie puede pillar al viento! [giggles] Entonces el árbol tiene una idea. Quietos, dice. {all:face normal} Y todos se quedan muy, muy quietos. [softly] El viento mira a su alrededor. Nadie corre. Así que el viento se tumba en la hierba alta, {butterfly:float loop 0.3} se hace un ovillo… y tararea. {all:face happy} [whispers] Chis. El viento está descansando.

wind-bed.prompt: a playful gentle breeze rustling through leaves and long grass

whoosh.prompt: a single soft comic whoosh of wind
